local_entities.label: Emergency Medical Hologram with mobile emitter

evidence.summary: Janeway returns to a disabled Voyager, finds biological residue and faint crew lifesigns, and encounters large hostile organisms moving through the ship.
The Doctor recounts responding to a Garan viral outbreak using his mobile emitter and observing microscopic viruses grow by absorbing host growth hormones and emerge as macroscopic organisms.
The Doctor identifies the macrovirus as the same organism at radically increased scale and reports that transporter biofilters initially failed to contain all viral material.
The virus infects crew, synthesizes host growth hormones, forms large organisms, and uses a piercing structure to infuse victims with its genetic code.
The Doctor develops an antigen and Janeway, already infected, becomes the first live test subject; the treatment cures her.
Janeway and the Doctor split up to restore environmental distribution; macroviruses overwhelm the Doctor and nearly destroy his autonomous emitter.
Tak Tak forces begin destroying Voyager as a contamination response, then grant Janeway one hour after she demonstrates that a cure exists.
With environmental controls damaged, Janeway uses infrared-emitting holodeck characters to attract macroviruses and destroys them with an antigen device while the Doctor reaches the crew.
After Voyager's infestation is destroyed, Janeway offers the antigen to the Tak Tak in exchange for ending their attack.
Voyager's crew recovers with only residual illness and ship damage; Janeway orders rest after the crisis.

neutral_coding.plot_problem: A microscopic virus becomes a ship-filling macroscopic lifeform that incapacitates Voyager while external responders prepare to destroy the contaminated vessel.
neutral_coding.epistemics: Doctor recollection, direct pathogen analysis, treatment result, and Tak Tak policy remain distinct.
neutral_coding.counterevidence: The organism's extraordinary growth is directly observed in-source and should not be generalized into real-world virology.
